name: wa
description: Bold magazine blog theme: a mosaic hero of notched image cards, numbered picks, topic chips and a night band, in cobalt and lime on cool paper.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees: light, dark, or auto (follows the visitor's system). Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.

density.title: Spacing
density.description: Compact tightens the space between home sections.

show_ticker.title: Show the ticker
show_ticker.description: The scrolling strip of topics and recent titles under the picks.

show_topics.title: Show topics
show_topics.description: The topic chips section on the home page.

show_archive_band.title: Show the archive band
show_archive_band.description: The dark band with older stories (needs more than five posts).

show_newsletter.title: Show the newsletter block
show_newsletter.description: The call-to-action inside the dark band. It links to a page; it has no form.

picks_heading.title: Picks heading
picks_heading.description: Heading of the picks section; the accent follows it.

picks_accent.title: Picks accent word
picks_accent.description: Italic word after the picks heading. Empty uses the first name of the featured post's author, or "us".

archive_heading.title: Archive heading
archive_heading.description: Start of the archive band heading.

archive_accent.title: Archive accent word
archive_accent.description: Italic word in the archive band heading.

archive_tail.title: Archive heading end
archive_tail.description: Words after the accent in the archive band heading.

queue_heading.title: Reading queue heading
queue_heading.description: Start of the last section's heading.

queue_accent.title: Reading queue accent word
queue_accent.description: Italic word in the last section's heading.

queue_tail.title: Reading queue heading end
queue_tail.description: Words after the accent in the last section's heading.

announce_text.title: Announcement text
announce_text.description: The pill under the hero. Leave empty to hide it.
announce_text.default: New stories are published here regularly.

announce_label.title: Announcement button
announce_label.description: Label of the button in the pill. Empty hides the button.

announce_url.title: Announcement link
announce_url.description: Where the button goes: a path such as /blog or a full address.

newsletter_accent.title: Newsletter accent word
newsletter_accent.description: Italic words in the newsletter heading.

newsletter_tail.title: Newsletter heading end
newsletter_tail.description: Words after the accent. Empty is fine.

newsletter_text.title: Newsletter text
newsletter_text.description: One line under the newsletter heading.
newsletter_text.default: Find out what is new, in one place.

newsletter_button.title: Newsletter button
newsletter_button.description: Label of the button; also the header button when the site has no header call to action. Empty hides both buttons.

newsletter_url.title: Newsletter link
newsletter_url.description: Where the button goes (a page with your sign-up form, for example). Empty hides the newsletter button and the header button.

signal_colour.title: Signal colour
signal_colour.description: Accent for chips, badges and the newsletter button. Text on it is a fixed dark ink, so choose a light colour. Type a hex value such as #c8f04a.

home_layout.title: Home page
home_layout.description: Auto shows the blocks built in the editor when the home page has several (or the site has no posts), and the magazine home otherwise. Choose Blocks or Magazine to force one.
